description: ParcelPal 1.2.11 remote-update edition. Merges upstream Vipshop/Dewu/PDD-Token/WebLogin updates, fixes widget background auto-sync and immediate desktop refresh without opening Scripting, resolves Taobao H5 commit early-readiness, and auto-transitions picked-up parcels.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.11 远程更新版：1) 完整合入原作者新版（新增唯品会/得物、拼多多 Token 免顶号登录、防遮挡内嵌登录页、删除记忆等）；2) 修复桌面小组件后台自动同步新单/取件码/物流并在变化后立即刷新桌面（无需点进 Scripting）；3) 保留淘宝 H5 commit 秒开与驿站/快递柜取件自动转已取。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.11 remote-update edition. Merges upstream updates, fixes widget background auto-sync and immediate desktop reload, and preserves Taobao H5 commit early-readiness and auto-pickup transitions.
